title: Checked Bag Allowances and Bag Fees — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Airport services tariff — checked bags.** The free checked-bag allowance of Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand is counted per passenger per direction of travel and depends on the fare brand and the itinerary class. Bag fees are in US dollars per bag.

## Free checked bags per passenger per direction

| Fare brand | Domestic | Short-haul international | Long-haul international |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Crestline First | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Bag fees (identical on every fare brand)

| Bag | Domestic | Short-haul international | Long-haul international |
|---|---|---|---|
| First bag | 35 prepaid online or in the app; 40 paid at the airport or through the call center | 35 | 75 |
| Second bag | 45 | 65 | 100 |
| Third and each further bag | 150 | 150 | 200 |

Row by row, the fee lines apply alike to Crestline Basic Economy, Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible, Crestline Premium Economy and Crestline First: first bag domestic online 35 and airport 40; second bag domestic 45; first bag short-haul international 35; second bag short-haul international 65; first bag long-haul international 75; second bag long-haul international 100; third and further bag on domestic and short-haul itineraries 150; third and further bag on long-haul itineraries 200.

## Worked reading (hypothetical)

A passenger on a Crestline Main Cabin long-haul international ticket has 1 free bag in each direction; the second bag checked in that direction is listed at 100 dollars and a third at 200 dollars. On a Crestline Main Flexible domestic ticket the first bag is free and a second bag is listed at 45 dollars.
